new_findings.title: Uncertainty-Aware MC Dropout for NBA Forecasting (MDPI Jan 2026)
new_findings.summary: RNN + Monte Carlo dropout for uncertainty quantification in NBA game forecasting. Integrates team performance, rolling-form indicators, spatial shot-chart embeddings. Brier competitive with 0.199 LR baseline.
new_findings.cpu_implementation: BaggingClassifier(base_estimator=ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=50), n_estimators=10, max_samples=0.8) as proxy for MC Dropout — average predicted probs across bags = calibrated ensemble output.
new_findings.actionability: HIGH — add 'bagging_et' and 'bagging_xgb' as model_type options in GA init/mutate. ~15 LOC.

new_findings.title: Calibration Selection +34.69% ROI vs Accuracy Selection
new_findings.summary: Systematic study: calibration as model selection criterion yields +34.69% ROI vs accuracy-based selection (-35.17%). Confirms Brier-minimization GA fitness is correct approach.
new_findings.fleet_relevance: P4 xgboost_brier = POL LIVE BEST 0.25022. Our GA fitness = Brier. Calibration mandate already in features/engine.py.
new_findings.actionability: CONFIRMATORY — no code change needed. Validates existing approach.

new_findings.title: Logistic Regression Brier 0.199, XGBoost 0.202 (literature benchmarks)
new_findings.summary: LR achieves Brier 0.199, XGBoost 0.202 on NBA data — both below our Colab TabICL best 0.21514. Critical caveat: may use different train/test splits or in-sample evaluation.
new_findings.actionability: HIGH — P7 runs LR (best 0.25412). Investigate methodology gap. Boost LR mutation weight in P7 GA. If OOS replicable, would be new fleet best by large margin.

new_findings.title: Stacked Ensemble Meta-Learner (Nature Scientific Reports 2025)
new_findings.summary: L1-regularized LR meta-learner over XGBoost/RF/CatBoost base models outperforms individual trees on NBA outcomes.
new_findings.actionability: MEDIUM — stacking banned on CPU islands (Rule 8). Feasible on Colab/GPU burst. Add to gpu-burst pipeline.
